choices: The tall ferns were already bending.
questions.answer: The tall ferns were already bending.
questions.evidenceText: The storm is coming from the east, said Clumsy. The tall ferns are already bending.

questions.prompt: How did Honky help everyone get ready?

questions.prompt: What kept the Dino Pals safe in the storm?
choices: Bossy's plan worked because Grumpy did every job.
The cave kept them safe without any preparation.
questions.rationale: Clumsy's height gave everyone a warning, Honky's voice gathered the Pals, and Shy's knowledge of hidden paths led them into Cozy Cave; Sunny's words "All of us" show that everyone used their different strengths together.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Clumsy stood tall and looked out over the whole Hollow. The storm is coming from the east, said Clumsy. The tall ferns are already bending. That gives us time.
Honky called all the Dino Pals from across the Hollow. One enormous blast. Every leaf fell off. But everyone heard and came running.
Shy, who knew every hidden corner of the Fernwood, led everyone to the deepest part of Cozy Cave. Shy knew exactly where it was warmest.

questions.evidenceText: We did that, said Sunny. All of us.
